name: Aluminium
description: A small collection of utility Rack modules.
author: Neil Baumberger

modules.name: Zones
modules.description: Splits a polyphonic MIDI-CV keyboard signal (V/OCT, GATE, VELOCITY, AFTERTOUCH, RETRIGGER) into two note-range zones, each independently configurable as polyphonic passthrough or monophonic with note-priority (last/highest/lowest) and true legato gate behavior

modules.name: Pads
modules.description: 16 gate outputs, one per learned note, driven by a polyphonic V/OCT + GATE cable (e.g. from Core MIDI-CV or Zones) instead of MIDI — learn a cell by clicking it and playing (or typing) the note; each cell can be switched to Latch mode to toggle on/off instead of following the held note

modules.name: PadX
modules.description: Pads expander: extracts a freely-labeled polyphonic lane (e.g. Velocity, Aftertouch, Retrigger) into 16 mono outputs, one per note Pads has learned
